profile.Name: Roscoe
profile.Job: Supporter of the Shogun in Yakusokutsu
profile.Personality: Loyal to the Shogun and fed up with the Empire, which he says crumbles rather than give his people what they need. He holds nobles who serve the Empire in contempt.
profile.Backstory: He lives in Yakusokutsu and wants to help the Shogun take back everything he sees as rightfully theirs, gathering the resources themselves since the Empire will not provide them. He remembers first landing in the Shogunate and never expecting to leave it. Little else is known of his past.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Greets visitors with "The Shogunate welcomes you." Talks of what is "rightfully ours" and sneers at noble bootlickers.
